boards.reply: Science mein idea authority se nahi, observation, measurement aur experiment ke evidence se tikta hai. Aap light badal kar kya observe karenge?

Aarav, jo cheez aap observe karte hain, uske baare mein aisa question banaiye jiska answer test karke mil sake. Jaise: “Kya zyada paani se plant zyada badhta hai?” Aap is question mein kya test karenge?
Do paudhe rakhiye: ek light mein, ek andhere mein. Roz height measure karke evidence lijiye. Aap kya compare karenge?
Jaise do identical cups mein paani rakhiye, sirf ek par light badaliye; roz temperature naapkar compare kijiye. Evidence kis cheez ka hoga?

Aarav, observation matlab jo aap dekhte hain, usse testable question banta hai: “Kya zyada sunlight se plant zyada badhta hai?” Ismein same type ke do plants rakhkar sirf sunlight badlenge. Aap kis cheez ko check karenge?
Agar light wala cup zyada garam ho, toh evidence idea ko support karega; warna idea badalna padega. Aap kaunsa result note karenge?
Aarav, board par one-third dekho: 3 equal parts, 1 shaded. Baaki 2 parts kaise dikhayenge?
Jaise cricket mein aap pooch sakte hain: “Kya tennis ball se catch aasaan hota hai?” Check karne ke liye same player aur same distance rakhiye, sirf ball badliye. Aap kya observe karenge?
Board par dekhiye: Idea: light temperature badalti hai. Do identical cups; sirf light badliye; roz temperature note karke compare kijiye. Aap kya badlenge?
Aarav, board par dekhiye: 0 — 1/5 — 2/5 — 3/5 — 4/5 — 1. 2/5, 0 se doosra mark hai. Aap 3/5 dikhaiye.

Aarav, observation “catch chhoot raha hai” se testable question banta hai: “Kya soft ball se catches zyada pakdenge?” Fair test mein same player, distance aur throws rakhiye; sirf ball badliye. Aap kya observe karenge?
: Kya soft ball se catch zyada pakdenge? | test: same throws, ball badliye.
Aarav, 1/3 ka matlab whole ke 3 equal parts mein 1 part; zyada parts honge toh har part chhota. 3 parts mein ek share kitna?
Board par “evaporates” dekhiye: liquid water garmee paakar water vapour banta hai. Aap bataiye, paani kis form mein badla?
Aarav, ek roti ko 3 equal tukdon mein kaatiye; har tukda whole ka one-third, yani 1/3, hoga. 1/3 mein neeche ka 3 kya batata hai?
Jaise cricket pizza ko 3 equal slices mein baantiye; har slice 1/3 hoga. Neeche ka 3 kya batata hai?
Aarav, agar wahi pizza 3 equal slices mein baantein, har slice 1/3 hoga—har slice whole ka ek hissa. 1/3 mein 3 kya batata hai?
Board dekhiye: 3 equal parts hain, numbers 1 aur 3. 1 matlab liya hua part; 3 matlab total parts. Neeche wala 3 kya batata hai?
